title: View Venue Availability (Coordinator)
note: Authoritative matrix: Confluence View Venue Availability Matrix (page 24117310), VEN-AVL-01 to VEN-AVL-10. This scope measures the shared VenueScheduleCalendar component so that the three lines owned by SPM-51 (28, 292, 296; coverage-exclusions.md) are counted in SPM-51 test cases. The standalone VenueScheduleCalendar.test.tsx carries SPM-51 comments but no VEN-AVL registry IDs, so the coverage-only scope sees its tests as untraced. The Playwright spec VenueScheduleCalendar.playwright.spec.ts is excluded from the vitest suite (vitest.config excludes *.playwright.spec.ts) and is not counted in this scope's coverage. Registry IDs for SPM-51 are not yet maintained.
